verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's developer docs say MCP clients such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and VS Code can connect to check your calendar, find open times, book meetings and manage your links. Its REST API also exposes available slots, event list/create/cancel, and scheduling-link management, so availability, bookings and event types are all covered. Missing for 10: detailed MCP server documentation (endpoint, tool list, auth setup), independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can use my scheduling account as a tool — an MCP server or tool-calling surface exposes availability, bookings, and event types

citations.quote: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, or another MCP client to check your calendar, find open times, book meetings, and manage your links from a chat.
List events GET /v1/events ... Cancel event POST /v1/events/{event_id}/cancel ... Create event POST /v1/links/{link_id}/events
